## The individual research note {#research-note}

::: {.two}
::: {}
**Task.** Two pages applying one Block 1 method to a decision or process in **your own research**.

State the decision or process, the data you have or would collect, the model, the assumptions, and what the model cannot tell you.

**Due** with the group report, proposed 6 February 2027.
:::
::: {}
```{=html}
<table class="wide">
  <thead><tr><th>Criterion</th><th class="num">Weight</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td>Correct use of the method</td><td class="num">50%</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Quality of assumptions</td><td class="num">30%</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Clarity</td><td class="num">20%</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```
[A small, correct model of a real decision scores better than a large model with unstated assumptions.]{.hint}
:::
:::

## Which method fits? {#method-match data-hold="true"}

```{=html}
<div class="widget" id="mm">
  <p id="mm-q" style="font-size:1.05em;margin:0 0 .5em"></p>
  <div class="w-controls" id="mm-b" role="group" aria-label="Methods"></div>
  <div class="w-readout" id="mm-out" aria-live="polite"></div>
  <div class="w-controls"><button type="button" class="w-btn" id="mm-next">Next case</button><span id="mm-n" style="margin-left:1em"></span></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('mm'); if (!root) return;
  root.addEventListener('click', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
  const M = ['Decision tree, EVSI', 'AHP', 'Monte Carlo', 'Markov chain', 'MDP', 'PERT, simulation', 'Maximal flow'];
  const C = [
    ['Your lab must decide whether to buy a second glovebox now or wait three months for a grant result.', 0, 'A decision now, an uncertain event, then a second decision: a tree. The value of waiting is the value of information.'],
    ['You log each coin cell every 50 cycles as good, fading or failed. Failed cells stay failed.', 3, 'States observed at fixed steps with an absorbing state: an absorbing Markov chain gives the expected life and the failure probabilities.'],
    ['You must pick one of three electrolyte suppliers on cost, purity, delivery time and safety documents.', 1, 'Several criteria, some without a common unit, weighed by judgment: AHP, with a consistency check.'],
    ['Your thesis has twelve tasks with dependencies and uncertain durations, and the defense date is fixed.', 5, 'Precedence plus uncertain durations: a network, and simulation for the on-time probability, because parallel paths merge.'],
    ['Each week you see how far the potentiostat has drifted and must decide whether to recalibrate it.', 4, 'An observed state, an action that changes the next state, and a cost per step: a Markov decision process.'],
    ['The NPV of a pilot electrolyzer depends on uncertain efficiency, electricity price and stack lifetime.', 2, 'One output driven by several uncertain inputs: Monte Carlo gives the whole distribution, not only the mean.'],
    ['The shared XRD facility receives samples from five groups through two preparation rooms and three instruments.', 6, 'Capacities on links between stages: maximal flow finds the throughput and the minimum cut finds the bottleneck.']
  ];
  let i = 0, right = 0, done = 0;
  document.getElementById('mm-b').innerHTML = M.map((m, k) => `<button type="button" class="w-choice" data-k="${k}">${m}</button>`).join('');
  function show() {
    document.getElementById('mm-q').innerHTML = `<b>Case ${i + 1} of ${C.length}.</b> ${C[i][0]}`;
    document.getElementById('mm-out').innerHTML = 'Choose the method that fits best.';
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-k]').forEach((b) => { b.disabled = false; b.removeAttribute('aria-pressed'); });
    document.getElementById('mm-n').textContent = done ? `Score: ${right} of ${done}` : '';
  }
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-k]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const k = +b.dataset.k, ok = k === C[i][1];
    done++; if (ok) right++;
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-k]').forEach((x) => { x.disabled = true; if (+x.dataset.k === C[i][1]) x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true'); });
    document.getElementById('mm-out').innerHTML = (ok ? '<span class="best">Yes.</span> ' : `Not quite: the better fit is <b>${M[C[i][1]]}</b>. `) + C[i][2];
    document.getElementById('mm-n').textContent = `Score: ${right} of ${done}`;
  }));
  document.getElementById('mm-next').addEventListener('click', () => { i = (i + 1) % C.length; if (i === 0) { right = 0; done = 0; } show(); });
  show();
})();
</script>
```

[Some cases admit a second method. In your note, say why you chose yours.]{.hint}

## Activity · Peer review and idea card {#act1 .activity data-hold="true"}

[Groups, then pairs · 25 minutes · review checklist and idea card]{.act-label}

::: {.prompt}
Part 1 (15 minutes). Swap your draft network plan with another group and review it against the checklist.
:::

::: {.two}
::: {}
1. Every activity and precedence is listed.
2. Durations have three estimates and a source.
3. The critical path and slack are correct.
:::
::: {}
4. The on-time probability comes from simulation, not PERT alone.
5. The crash decision states its cost.
6. Shared crews or equipment are checked.
:::
:::

::: {.prompt}
Part 2 (10 minutes). Write a three-sentence idea card for your research note: the decision, the method, the data. Swap with a partner and ask one question about their card.
:::
